name: Shinnyuu R
source:
The near future. Humanity has entered the age of intergalaxy travel. A famous pharmaceutical company mines deep space for resources -- a scientist and her team travel on a corporate ship. But with time running short on their mission, they change route and trespass into unconfirmed space... only to realize they were not alone... 

Mika, Karen and Cassie ravished by alien tentacles! 
In space, no one can hear you cream... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106792.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
不久的未来，人类进入星际旅行时代。一家著名制药公司在深空采集资源，一名科学家与团队乘坐企业飞船出发。然而任务时间所剩无几，他们改变航线，闯入未经确认的宇宙区域……却发现那里并非空无一物……

米卡、凯伦和凯茜遭到外星触手蹂躏！

在太空中，没人听得见你的高潮……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106792.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
